# Commander Names

Write your own lists of commander names, so your Dwarf Captains go by Gimli and Balin.

A name list is `newnametype`, followed by its `addname` commands, then `end`. Give it to a monster with the game's `nametype "<list>"`, and the game names its commanders from the list at random. The list must exist before that line, in this mod or an earlier one. Put that `nametype` line in the .c5se or on a `#!@` line: the game alone can't read a list's name.

!!! info "More in the game's manual"
    `nametype` and the game's other monster commands are in Illwinter's official modding manual, under ["Monster Modding"](https://www.illwinter.com/coe5/coe5modding.pdf#page=14).

### newnametype "&lt;list&gt;" { #newnametype .command data-toc-label="newnametype" data-added="2.4" }

Creates a list of commander names. Using a list's name again adds to that list, from this mod or another.

- **list:** The list's name, in double quotes.

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newnametype "Dwarf Names"
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@newnametype "Dwarf Names"
    ```

### addname "&lt;name&gt;" { #addname .command data-toc-label="addname" data-added="2.4" }

Adds a name to the list.

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    addname "Gimli"
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@addname "Gimli"
    ```

### fixedname "&lt;name&gt;" { #fixedname .command data-toc-label="fixedname" data-added="2.4" }

Gives every commander of this monster this name. Goes after `newmonster` or `selectmonster`.

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    fixedname "Gandalf"
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@fixedname "Gandalf"
    ```

### Example names { #example }

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newnametype "Dwarf Names"
    addname "Gimli"
    addname "Balin"
    end

    selectmonster "Dwarf Captain"
    nametype "Dwarf Names"

    selectmonster "Grey Wizard"
    fixedname "Gandalf"
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@newnametype "Dwarf Names"
    #!@addname "Gimli"
    #!@addname "Balin"
    #!@end

    selectmonster "Dwarf Captain"
    nametype "Dwarf Names"

    selectmonster "Grey Wizard"
    #!@fixedname "Gandalf"
    ```
